meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 为选定的 NanoClaw agent 组注册 Tavily 远程 MCP 服务。装好后 Claude 等支持 MCP 的 provider 会多出 tavily_search(网页搜索)和 tavily_extract(网页提取)两个工具,无需 API key。
howto.when: 当你给某个 agent 组安装无 API key 的 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取工具时触发;已在 Claude provider 上的组本身另有内置 WebSearch 和 WebFetch。

say.text: 给 agent 组 <group-id> 装上 Tavily 搜索和提取
say.note: 会先查镜像里是否已有 mcp-remote 桥接

say.text: 重启这个组,跑一次 max_results 为 1 的 Tavily 搜索
say.note: 用来验证注册是否生效

say.text: Tavily 返回 429 了,帮我走升级流程
say.note: 会引导用免费 API key 升级

howto.what_en: Registers Tavily's remote MCP server for selected NanoClaw agent groups, giving Claude and other MCP-capable providers two tools: tavily_search and tavily_extract, with no API key needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when installing keyless Tavily web search or URL extraction for an agent group; groups on the Claude provider already have built-in WebSearch and WebFetch.

say_en.text: Add Tavily search and extract to agent group <group-id>
say_en.note: Checks the image for an existing mcp-remote bridge first

say_en.text: Restart that group and run one Tavily search with max_results 1
Tavily returned 429, walk me through the upgrade
say_en.note: Guides the free API key upgrade
